snippet.title: MICROMEGA - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://bit.ly/micromegaYT

MICROMEGA blends hand-drawn artistry with intricate puzzles in a surreal 2D physics-based adventure. Guide a fragile Sphere through the unique world of visual artist Mani, interacting with its creatures to unlock paths and overcome challenges. A mesmerizing journey of beauty and fun!
